Title: Historic Event! This Friday 10 AM at The Shul


                                                        Dear Friends,

  If you will be in South Florida this Friday, please make every effort to attend a
   45-minute ceremony 10 AM at Aleph's headquarters at The Shul to show your
  support, gratitude and respect for those that dedicate their lives to protect our
  freedoms. Everyone is urged to attend this unique and historic event. We look
                                forward to seeing you.
